visualCharacteristics.purpose: enquiry / complaint web form with optional help panel, built from authored config

contentPattern.structure: content rows (heading, intro); config rows [form | action | submit | help | success | error | required note] [value]; field rows [label] [type: text, email, tel, number, date, url, textarea, select, radio, checkbox, heading, hidden] [options (comma list) or placeholder] [required: yes]. `form` may link to a form definition spreadsheet (.json: Name, Type, Label, Placeholder, Options, Mandatory, Value, Help). Submits JSON {data} via POST to `action`

reuseGuidance: Use for enquiry, complaint and application forms. alt option renders a compact single-column form (e.g. a single enquiry-type field).
